description: Generated from authored prediction calls and independent KP1-H expectations; do not edit.

cases.title: heights at the basic station over one day, every 600 s (the default step)
heights_at: one item per instant, in the given order, repeats kept
series times are start + k * step_s, not aligned to a grid or the clock
start == stop gives an empty result
the step at 2010-01-01T00:00:00Z: each sample uses its own year's tables
heights across 29 February 2012 and at the end of the leap year
a naive datetime (no zone) is invalid_argument (Python only)
an instant at 12:00:00.7 is floored to 12:00:00 and gives the whole-second height (TypeScript, Python, Ruby)
cases.note: steps 0 and 2 have the items of steps 1 and 3 (same_items_as_step); the strict mode gets the floored instants
